Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Serum Glucose 100-126 mg/dl
  -  Waist C >89/102 cm; F/ [OR] M
  -  Serum HDL-C: <50/40 mg/dl; F/ [OR] M
  -  Serum TG: >150 mg/dl
  -  BP >130/85 mmHg
  -  Serum Endotoxin >25 EU/ml
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Unstable body mass (±2 kg over prior 3-mo)
  -  Vegetarian
  -  Food allergies  [OR] or lactose intolerance
  -  User of dietary supplements  [OR] or probiotics (within past 1-mo)
  -  Pregnancy, [OR]  lactation, changes in birth control (within 6-mo)
  -  Any gastrointestinal disorders
  -  Chronic diarrhea
  -  Smoker
  -  Excess alcohol (>2 drinks/d)
  -  Excess aerobic exercise (>5 h/wk)
  -  Recent antibiotic  [OR] or anti-inflammatory agent use
  -  BP >140/90 mmHg
